meta_description:
21K likes, 536 comments - apple on October 20, 2026: "Above Rose Valley, the runway looks different.

The day before the @lesbenjamins show, director @neels.castillon sent iPhone into the sky over Cappadocia, mounted on custom-built drones. 

Titled “From Earth to Sky”, the fashion film captures the surreal anniversary collection.

#ShotoniPhone18Pro by @neels.castillon".
